hook: Arthur Mensch spent two and a half years researching large language models at Google DeepMind before deciding, alongside longtime friends Guillaume Lample and Timothee Lacroix, that a European lab could compete at the frontier while keeping its models open. The three co-founded Mistral AI in Paris in April 2023, and Mensch has run the company as CEO since, positioning it as an open-weight counterweight to closed labs in the US. He holds a doctorate in machine learning from Paris-Saclay University, following earlier study at Ecole Polytechnique and Telecom Paris, and in 2025 was named a Knight of the French National Order of Merit.

standing.standing: Arthur Mensch stands as co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, a research lab in Paris, France, founded in 2023. He has run the company as CEO since its founding in April 2023, alongside co-founders Guillaume Lample and Timothee Lacroix. The records show he worked as a research scientist at Google DeepMind for about two and a half years, focused on large language models. He holds a doctorate in machine learning from Paris-Saclay University, after study at Ecole Polytechnique and Telecom Paris. In May 2025 he was named a Knight of the French National Order of Merit. He has publicly maintained Mistral's open-weight strategy while denying IPO plans in March 2025.
